name: Carbophos
summary: Carbophos is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses a combination of moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters trades when fast and slow moving averages cross in the direction of the prevailing trend confirmed by ADX strength. The EA includes built-in position management with trailing stops and fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels.
summary_zh: Carbophos是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，结合均线交叉和动量指标来识别并跟随市场趋势。当快慢均线在ADX确认的趋势方向上交叉时开仓。EA内置仓位管理功能，包含移动止损和固定的止盈止损水平。
strategy_analysis: Carbophos策略的核心概念是基于双重均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，辅以ADX指标过滤弱势行情避免假突破。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线发生金叉或死叉，且ADX值高于阈值确认趋势强度足够。出场条件包括触及固定止盈止损、均线反向交叉信号、以及移动止损被触发。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，没有使用马丁格尔或网格加仓策略。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损控制，但在仓位缩放方面相对简单，缺乏根据波动率动态调整的机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Carbophos strategy is a dual moving average crossover trend-following system supplemented by ADX indicator filtering to avoid false breakouts in weak markets. Entry conditions require a golden cross or death cross between fast and slow moving averages with ADX value above a threshold confirming sufficient trend strength. Exit conditions include hitting fixed take-profit or stop-loss levels, a reverse moving average crossover signal, or trailing stop activation. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance, without employing martingale or grid scaling strategies. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily maximum loss controls, but the position scaling mechanism is relatively simple and lacks dynamic volatility-based adjustment.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，均线交叉搭配ADX过滤有效减少假信号
设有固定止损和移动止损，风险控制机制相对完善
不使用马丁格尔或网格策略，避免了爆仓的极端风险
趋势跟踪策略在强势行情中表现良好，能够捕获中长期趋势
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic with MA crossover plus ADX filtering effectively reduces false signals
Fixed stop-loss and trailing stop provide relatively sound risk control mechanisms
No martingale or grid strategies used, avoiding the extreme risk of account blowout
Trend-following approach performs well in strong trending markets, capturing medium-to-long-term trends
cons: 均线交叉系统存在明显滞后性，入场和出场时机偏晚导致利润回吐
震荡行情中频繁产生虚假交叉信号，可能导致连续亏损
仓位管理缺乏根据市场波动率动态调整的机制，固定手数在高波动时风险偏大
未包含点差过滤机制，在高压差品种上交易成本可能侵蚀利润
cons_en: MA crossover system has noticeable lag, causing late entries and exits that lead to profit givebacks
Frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets can lead to consecutive losses
Position sizing lacks dynamic volatility-based adjustment; fixed lots carry higher risk during high volatility
No spread filter included, so trading costs on high-spread instruments may erode profitability
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H4趋势方向上只做H1同向交叉信号，减少假信号
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损距离和仓位大小
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., only taking H1 crossover signals aligned with H4 trend direction to reduce false signals
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit that automatically adjusts distance and position size based on market volatility

risk_points: 均线滞后性导致止损被触发前已有较大浮亏
缺乏点差过滤在高压差环境下可能频繁止损
固定止损在低波动行情中可能过大而在高波动行情中过小
risk_points_en: MA lag may result in significant floating loss before stop-loss is triggered
Lack of spread filter may cause frequent stop-outs in high-spread environments
Fixed stop-loss may be too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility conditions
